summary: Soonchunhyang University (SCH) is a private university in Asan, South Chungcheong province, South Korea, about 52 miles (88 km) southwest of Seoul. Founded in 1978 by Dr. Succ-Jo Suh as a medical college with 80 students, it expanded into a comprehensive university in 1980 offering undergraduate and graduate programs. The note also cites rankings: 31st among South Korean universities by the JoongAng Ilbo in 2009 and 151st among Asia-Pacific universities by Chosun-QS Asia in 2010.
one_line: Soonchunhyang University is a private comprehensive university founded in 1978 in Asan, South Korea, with notable national and regional rankings.
key_facts: Soonchunhyang University (SCH) is a private university in South Korea.
Soonchunhyang University is located in the city of Asan, South Chungcheong province.
Asan is about 52 miles (88 km) southwest of Seoul.
Soonchunhyang University was founded by Dr. Succ-Jo Suh in 1978.
Soonchunhyang University was founded as a medical college with 80 students.
Soonchunhyang University expanded to become a comprehensive university in 1980.
Soonchunhyang University offers both undergraduate and graduate programs.
In 2009, Soonchunhyang University was ranked 31st among all South Korean universities in a comprehensive evaluation by the JoongAng Ilbo.
In 2010, Soonchunhyang University was ranked 151st among Asia-Pacific universities by Chosun-QS Asia.
